name: Citra Nusantara Gemilang Tbk.
summary: Operating as an energy enterprise, PT Citra Nusantara Gemilang Tbk primarily focuses on supplying and distributing compressed natural gas (CNG) across Indonesia. Its services cater to a diverse clientele, including industrial facilities, retail businesses, and the transportation sector. Beyond gas distribution, the firm also engages in the sale of various gas-related equipment. All its offerings are presented under the distinctive GASRA brand. The company, which was established in 2005, maintains its principal office in Bekasi, Indonesia.
